newsitem.title: TURKEY: Strategic Kurdish town in Iraq falls to rival.
newsitem.headline: Strategic Kurdish town in Iraq falls to rival.

text.p: Guerrillas of the Kurdistan Democratic Party (KDP), backed by Iraqi government forces, have taken the strategic town of Degala, a rival Kurdish faction said on Sunday.

Latif Rashid of the London office of the PUK (Patriotic Union of Kurdistan) told Reuters in Istanbul: "Iraqi troops supported by KDP tanks and artillery have taken Degala. I confirm that Degala has fallen".
